landing.heroDescription: Visual calendar, automatic notifications and real-time sync for your church volunteers.
landing.typewriterFull: Leading Engagement for Volunteers In the Church

slides.smartSchedulesDesc: Create weekly or monthly schedules in a few clicks. The system distributes volunteers automatically.
slides.autoNotificationsDesc: Volunteers get WhatsApp reminders before their commitment, without you doing anything.
slides.realtimeConfirmationsDesc: Track who confirmed, who requested a swap and who hasn't responded — all in one panel.
slides.scheduleSwapsDesc: Volunteers request swaps directly in the app, no need to talk to the leader every time.
slides.multipleTeamsDesc: Worship, reception, media, children — manage as many teams as you need in one place.
slides.sectorsAndRolesDesc: Organize members by sectors and assign specific roles for each schedule.
slides.step1Desc: Sign up in less than 2 minutes. Completely free.
slides.step2Desc: Register volunteers and organize by ministry or sector.
slides.step3Desc: Set dates and the system takes care of the rest automatically.
slides.step4Desc: Confirmations and pending items in real-time on the dashboard.
slides.ctaDesc: Join the volunteers who have already simplified schedule management at their church. 100% free
